mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it indicates a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces consumer and business spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 40% of cases when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate indicates a weakening labor market, which may lead to decreased consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE rises, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts suggests strong demand in the housing market, which may boost related industries and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 30% of cases when HOUST > 2000, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production indicates supply chain issues, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 50% of cases when INDPRO < 100, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When both the unemployment rate decreases and payroll employment increases, it signals a strong labor market, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of cases when UNRATE decreases and PAYEMS increases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, slowing GDP growth may indicate upcoming economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 50% of cases during late-cycle expansion, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 3%, it indicates a loose monetary policy, which may stimulate investment and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of cases when FEDFUNDS < 3%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) is high and the federal funds rate is low, it may indicate a specific policy stance that could lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 30% of cases when CPIAUCSL is high and FEDFUNDS is low, the hypothesis is rejected.
